name: Trailers4Jellyfin
description: Automatically downloads trailers for upcoming and recently released movies not in your library, from TMDB/YouTube, and plays them before your movies (built-in Cinema Mode). Requires Jellyfin 12 or later. Never downloads AV1 video (H.264/AAC for players without AV1 decode, e.g. Nvidia Shield 2019) and skips dubbed trailers in favour of original audio.
overview: Cinema-style trailers for movies you haven't seen yet

versions.changelog:
- Releases are now published to the public Grassth/jellyfin-plugins repository; add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Grassth/jellyfin-plugins/main/manifest.json as the plugin repository
- Settings page Help link opens the public plugin repository README

- Fork of Awatatah/Trailers4Jellyfin v2.2.0.0 with:
- Fix: never download AV1 video; yt-dlp prefers H.264 + AAC in .mp4 so trailers direct-play on devices without hardware AV1 decode (e.g. Nvidia Shield TV 2019)
- Fix: yt-dlp picks YouTube's original audio track instead of auto-dubbed tracks
- Fix: TMDB trailers titled as dubs are skipped; the movie's original language is always requested, and subtitled / original-language official trailers are ranked first
- Add: settings toggles 'Exclude AV1 codec' and 'Exclude dubbed trailers' (both on by default)
- Security: yt-dlp arguments are passed as a list, so a crafted TMDB title can no longer inject yt-dlp flags (from upstream robadieNZ v1.0.18.0)
- Fix: leftover partial downloads are cleaned up and never counted, processed or played as trailers (from upstream robadieNZ v1.0.18.0)
